bill.title: Authorizing the Clerk to inform the President of the election of the Speaker and the Clerk.
bill.latestActionText: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
subjects: Presidents and presidential powers, Vice Presidents
bill.officialSummary: This resolution provides for the President to be informed that Rep. Mike Johnson of Louisiana has been elected as Speaker and Kevin McCumber has been elected as Clerk of the House of Representatives of the 119th Congress.

classification.plainSummary:
This resolution provides for the President to be informed that Rep. Mike Johnson of Louisiana has been elected as Speaker and Kevin McCumber has been elected as Clerk of the House of Representatives of the 119th Congress.

This is a internal procedural measure ("Authorizing the Clerk"). It carries no sector tags and no donor overlap is computed for it, because attributing an economic interest to a commemorative or procedural measure would be misleading.

plain.whatItDoes: This is Congress running its own house. It sets a rule, a seat or a date for Congress itself. It does not change any law.
plain.whoItTouches: Nobody directly — this is Congress handling its own affairs.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing changes for you. No rule and no payment changes.
plain.source: From the bill title, and from the subject labels that library staff put on it.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
